visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a cozy indoor setting, a man with short black hair wearing a white t-shirt and black shorts sits on a beige sofa next to a Shiba Inu. He looks at the dog and gestures with his hands while the dog looks back at him. A dog-face cushion sits on the sofa back behind them. (2) A transition filled with animated hearts leads to an outdoor scene where the man walks the dog on a leash along a sidewalk bordered by lush green trees. They later run together across a wide, sunlit grassy field in a park. (3) The man visits a coffee processing area where multiple metal trays are filled with roasted brown coffee beans and some red cherries. The dog stands nearby, observing the scene. The lighting is bright and natural. (4) Graphics appear on a white background showing the 2025 Taiwan Coffee Festival logo and a map of the region. A digital stamp animation clicks onto a phone screen interface. (5) The man visits an old Japanese-style wooden house with large glass windows and tatami flooring. He is seen pouring dark coffee and later eating a plate of curry with a breaded cutlet. He holds his phone to scan a QR code at a wooden counter. (6) Outdoors at a farm, the man and an older man in glasses and a black vest examine the green leaves of coffee plants. The man sits at a table and eats a purple frozen popsicle, showing it to the camera while the dog sits beside him. (7) At a rustic cafe with red brick walls and traditional lanterns, the man drinks from a white cup while the dog lies down on a dark wooden bench. Shelves with various coffee packages and award certificates are shown. (8) In the final scene, the man and dog sit on a yellow ledge in a park under soft daylight. He holds two small colorful cups. A promotional graphic with a schedule for the coffee festival appears as a full-screen overlay.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with the energetic whining and high-pitched vocalizations of a dog, immediately followed by the primary male narrator's friendly, conversational voice. The background music is a cheerful acoustic track featuring bright guitar strumming at a steady 125 BPM. The vocal delivery is clear and enthusiastic, set against a quiet indoor noise floor. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect accompanies a transition, and the ambient noise shifts to a very subtle outdoor atmosphere with faint rustling. The music maintains a constant volume and positive major-key tonality, synchronized with the narrator's descriptions of walking his dog. (3) A series of digital 'ding' sound effects trigger as promotional graphics appear. The narrator's speech rate is moderate and well-enunciated. A light percussive 'crunch' sound is heard when the man eats a popsicle, layered over the continuous acoustic background music. (4) As the narration moves through cafe descriptions, the acoustic mix remains stable. The sound of coffee being poured into a cup provides a transient acoustic event. The overall audio design is clean and professionally balanced, with the primary speech clearly separated from the music bed. (5) The video concludes with a final energetic vocal phrase from the narrator, ending with a rhythmic music flourish and a final bright digital chime effect. The spectral balance remains consistently bright and polished throughout.
